verdict.rationale: Text quoted verbatim from several canada.ca guidance pages (business registration overview, e-services, EFILE, CRA home) implies the public reading surface returned extractable server-side content. The platform probes also got plain HTTP responses (a 302 to the error page, then a 200 error page) with no challenge recorded. However, no probe directly documents fetching the guidance pages as a keyless agent with an identified user agent, or confirms the absence of a bot wall, CAPTCHA or JS-only shell, and the llms.txt probe shows no agent-oriented index. Missing for 10: an explicit hands-on fetch of guidance pages with a declared bot user agent showing a 200 response with server-rendered content, confirmation of no CAPTCHA or bot-challenge across the docs surface, and independent corroboration.
